name: create-mexn-app-templates
description: Monorepo containing backend templates for create-mexn-app

scripts.test:all: npm --prefix cjs test && npm --prefix esm-js test && npm --prefix esm-ts test
scripts.lint:all: npm --prefix cjs run lint && npm --prefix esm-js run lint && npm --prefix esm-ts run lint
scripts.lint:fix:all: npm --prefix cjs run lint:fix && npm --prefix esm-js run lint:fix && npm --prefix esm-ts run lint:fix
scripts.format:check:all: npm --prefix cjs run format:check && npm --prefix esm-js run format:check && npm --prefix esm-ts run format:check
scripts.format:fix:all: npm --prefix cjs run format && npm --prefix esm-js run format && npm --prefix esm-ts run format:fix

author: Dony M Varkey
